title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. translated_title: Seer：利用共享决策模型引导小型深度研究智能体
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体需要反复决定搜索什么、阅读什么以及验证什么，通常依赖大型云端托管语言模型来进行动作提议。然而，出于隐私和本地控制的考虑，用户希望在个人设备上运行智能体，而设备上有限的内存和算力更适合小型模型，并使设备端训练变得困难。同时，推理时引导面临三大障碍：通过真实执行来探索替代方案会增加工具调用次数；基于提示的自我评估受限于智能体自身的判断水平；而针对特定模型的引导则面临重复适配的成本。我们提出Seer，一个推理时框架，它提供本地化引导，将智能体的动作提议与学习到的后果预测和价值估计相分离。基于共享的真实研究轨迹语料库，我们训练了两个模型：一个是在观测到的调用—响应对上训练的工具响应模拟器，另一个是在以折扣终末正确性标注的历史记录上训练的价值估计器。
tldr: Seer是一个推理时引导框架，通过从共享的真实研究轨迹中学习工具响应模拟器和价值估计器，为资源受限设备上的小型深度研究智能体提供决策引导，避免了设备端训练和重复适配的成本。
en_tdlr: Seer is an inference-time framework that guides small deep-research agents on resource-constrained devices by learning a tool-response simulator and a value estimator from a shared corpus of real research trajectories, avoiding on-device training and repeated adaptation costs.
